answer_1.quote: We leveraged large language models (LLMs) to ... transform stigmatizing language into more empathetic and inclusive ... resulting in 1,649 de‑stigmatized pairs.
answer_1.outputs: de‑stigmatized text (original post paired with revised, less stigmatizing version)

answer_2.quote: We conducted a stylistic similarity analysis using LIWC to compare original stigmatizing posts with their de‑stigmatized versions generated by our models... A pairwise two‑way t‑test showed no significant differences...

answer_4.quote: Human evaluation. To assess the effectiveness of our six systems ... we conducted a human evaluation with five reviewers on a random sample of 110 posts (a total of 660 generated texts).
answer_4.guideline: Reviewers were instructed to rank systems on overall quality, de‑stigmatization, and faithfulness using criteria such as naturalness, cohesion, appropriateness, human‑likeness, and faithfulness.
